$description: Motion. The house rule is fades: opacity transitions at --dur-base. Transform motion is permitted only where a surface enters or leaves the viewport — a drawer sliding in, a command palette rising on open — because that movement tells the reader where the surface came from. It is prohibited on any surface already on screen: no movement on hover, focus, selection, or state change. No bounce, spring, scale, or blur in any context. Amended August 2026 from an unqualified fades-only rule, which two entering surfaces had always contravened; the rule now describes what the system does and stays enforceable.

ease-soft.$description: Default soft-out easing. Fades, hovers, and popover drifts.

ease-crisp.$description: Sharper standard easing, for mechanical movement.

dur-base.$description: The default. Fades and panel transitions.

dur-slow.$description: Large reveals, and surfaces entering or leaving the viewport.
